fusions.name: Misdirected Buzz
fusions.desc: Flicks a stinger that deals 4 damage. It has a 15% chance to turn the target against its own allies for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Short Change
fusions.desc: A sting that consumes every affliction on the target, adding 1.5 times their remaining damage to a blow that deals 14 damage. It only strikes a target at or below 25% health.

fusions.name: Decoy Chorus
fusions.desc: A challenge that pulls up to 5 enemies within 8 tiles onto you for 6 seconds. Decoy stingers fight beside you for 10 seconds, striking for 4 every 1.4 seconds.

fusions.name: Wrong Target
fusions.desc: Your dodge chance rises by 12% against enemies carrying your afflictions.
